meta.name: paid-ads-x
meta.description: Audit, diagnose, and safely operate connected X Ads (Twitter Ads) accounts through the NotFair MCP. Use for X Ads performance, campaign or line-item analysis, spend, conversions, targeting, promoted posts, audiences, budgets, bids, creative, campaign setup, or approved X Ads changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计诊断X广告数据,优化投放策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在运营 X 平台广告,需要分析数据并调整投放
copy.tagline_en: Audit and optimize your X Ads campaign performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage X Ads accounts and need to analyze and adjust campaigns

howto.what: 连接 X 广告账户后,Claude 会先确认连接和账户设置,再读取广告数据,分析表现、花费、转化等,指出主要贡献、风险和下一步建议;只有在你批准后,它才会修改预算、定向等设置,并先预览风险、事后核对结果。
howto.when: 当用户询问 X 广告的表现、花费、转化,或要求分析/调整广告系列、预算、定向等,或执行已批准的 X 广告修改时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个广告系列上周的花费和转化,找出最值得优化的地方。
say.note: 技能会读取账户数据并给出数据支持的诊断。

say.text: 把广告系列 X 的每日预算从 100 改成 200,先做风险预览。
say.note: 它会先展示改动前后的风险,在你确认后才执行。

say.text: 检查所有广告组的定向设置,列出可疑项。
say.note: 它会核查定向条件与平台 ID,并区分事实与推断。

howto.what_en: Claude verifies the X Ads connection, reads account data, analyzes spend and conversions, and suggests next steps. It only mutates budget/targeting after user approval, previewing risk and confirming results.
howto.when_en: When the user asks about X Ads performance, spend, conversions, or requests analysis/adjustment of campaigns, budgets, targeting, or execution of approved X Ads changes.

say_en.text: Analyze this campaign's spend and conversions; suggest where to optimize.
say_en.note: Skill reads account data and gives data-backed diagnostics.

say_en.text: Change campaign X's daily budget from 100 to 200, but preview the risk first.
say_en.note: It shows before/after risk and waits for your confirmation.

say_en.text: Audit targeting across all ad groups and list anything suspicious.
say_en.note: It checks targeting names and platform IDs, separating facts from inference.
